## Review checklist

- [ ] Upstream links and dates are correct.
- [ ] New entries are metadata only, unless evidence is included.
- [ ] No protocol meaning has been inferred from a commit title alone.
- [ ] Verified findings are promoted to the relevant page under `docs/`.
- [ ] Unverified findings remain in `research/`.
- [ ] Sensitive device, account or location data is not included.

## Summary

Describe which upstream changes were reviewed and which documentation pages, if
any, were updated.
